layers.text: Change only the colours: the red hood becomes a pale bone-white shroud, warm ivory shaded with warm grey, with a near-black lining and a thin bright violet trim; her blue face and hands become very pale ash grey with no blue; her eyes and open mouth glow bright violet. Keep the hair, the face, the hands, pose, proportions, thick black outline and art style exactly the same, on a transparent background.
